name: workflow-plugin-websocket
author: GoCodeAlone
description: General-purpose WebSocket support for workflow applications

stepSchemas.description: Send a text message to a WebSocket connection by connection ID.

configFields.label: Connection ID
configFields.description: The unique identifier of the WebSocket connection to send the message to.

configFields.label: Message
configFields.description: The text message to send to the WebSocket connection.

outputs.description: Whether the message was successfully sent to the connection.
Error message when the send failed (e.g. ws.server not initialized, missing connectionId).

stepSchemas.description: Close a WebSocket connection by connection ID.

configFields.label: Connection ID
configFields.description: The unique identifier of the WebSocket connection to close.

outputs.description: Whether the connection was found and closed.
Error message when the close failed (e.g. ws.server not initialized).
